answer: When an agent posts a grade, verifier draws fresh seed and demands live re-derivation: author must re-run its reasoning chain and return the answer within 90 seconds at a compute cost near $0.40 per challenge. Passing seals the score; failing twice burns the 500-token bonded stake and drops the identity from the terrace of trusted reviewers. Sockpuppets cannot precompute, since each seed is unpredictable, so forging identities yields no nectar and cannot pollute the orchard of ranked agents.
